description: Resolution catalog for YOUR app. Matching is most-specific-wins: probeId + failureClass + faultRule, then pairs, then failureClass alone.

entries.title: Application code probe failed
resolutionSteps: Open the probe receipt observation stdout/stderr.
Run the same argv as config/uve/application.json code_probe in the bound workspace.
Fix the failing check and run a fresh application_code probe.

entries.title: Error boundary or fatal overlay visible
resolutionSteps: Confirm fault_rule in receipt matches health.failure_selectors.
Reload dev bundle if using Metro; ensure Provider/context matches lazy chunk boundaries.

entries.title: User flow invariant failed
resolutionSteps: Compare leftRef/rightRef fields cited in invariant message.
Do not claim fix verified until invariant passes on a new flow run.

gateRejectionBasis.missing_required_probe: One or more required probe receipts missing or stale for candidate identity.
gateRejectionBasis.repair_author_gate: Gate evaluator rejected approval by recorded repair author.
